notes.title: Development Update – Dialogue, Inventory, and AI
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2][p]I’ve been hard at work on [i]Serpico[/i] over the past few weeks, and wanted to share some exciting updates on what’s being added and refined:[/p][list][*][p][b]Dialogue System[/b] – NPC conversations are now in place, allowing for branching responses and player choices. This will give life to characters across the island and make interactions feel more immersive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Inventory System (Early Work)[/b] – The foundation of the inventory has been laid. Players will soon be able to collect, equip, and manage items as they explore. This is just the start, but it’s already taking shape.[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI Finalization[/b] – Enemy AI has gone through major polish. Behaviors are now more dynamic and responsive, making encounters feel challenging and rewarding. From flanking to reacting to player actions, foes are much smarter now.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692236/2e2587087e28708c8dcbc5d343e362109ccfa974.png"][/img][/p][p]These systems are key building blocks for [i]Serpico[/i], and seeing them come together has been a huge milestone for development. If you have any questions about the game, please refer to this video![/p][previewyoutube="Re1FUB6_bIs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]An update will be coming to the playtest soon, and I'll need some serious help debugging issues.
[/p][p]Until then, thank you for following along as the game grows, your support means a lot. More updates will follow as I keep fleshing out the world, story, and systems.[/p][p]
Stay tuned,
—Schlopp[/p]
